title: DECISION: sanitize_display strips ANSI SGR escapes defensively
description:
What: sanitize_display(s) parses ESC [ ... m patterns and strips them, returning only visible characters.

Why it's good: Prevents terminal injection attacks from untrusted message bodies. If a malicious peer sends color codes or cursor movement escapes, they are stripped at display time. The function is pure (no I/O), handles the full UTF-8 pipeline, and is tested with hardcoded escape sequences. Applied to all user-facing text: chat names, contact display names, message bodies.
